notes:
Indicates that something is suitable or intended for consumption as food. Composed of {食|しょく} (eat, food) and ⟦{用|よう}→〜用：09842_you⟧ (use, purpose). Often used to distinguish edible items from non-edible or decorative versions of the same thing.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {食用|しょくよう}{油|あぶら}/{油|ゆ}: cooking oil
- {食用|しょくよう}キノコ: edible mushroom
- {食用|しょくよう}{花|ばな}: edible flower
- {食用|しょくよう}⟦{色素|しきそ}→色素：19991_shikiso⟧: food coloring
- {食用|しょくよう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{適|てき}する→適する：02297_tekisuru⟧: suitable for consumption

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {飲食用|いんしょくよう}: for food and drink — includes beverages
- ⟦{観賞用|かんしょうよう}→観賞用：22026_kanshouyou⟧: for viewing/decorative use — contrasts with {食用|しょくよう}
- ⟦{薬用|やくよう}→薬用：30092_yakuyou⟧: for medicinal use — another common -⟦{用|よう}→〜用：09842_you⟧ compound
